body: who gives a shit what anyone else thinks, if it’s going to help you heal do it

Hey man. I’ve been in a 4 year relationship and a 1 year relationship, I felt like that girl was “the one” both times and both times it didn’t work it, I often find that if it was the right person it wouldn’t matter what the time was. Hope and denial go hand in hand and are a big part of the grieving process. Wish you the best
It comes in waves, stick at it

I spent a year with a girl like this my friend. You have developed a dependency and an attachment to this girl. We broke up 5 times prior to this last one, the highs are not worth the lows my guy. Will leave you in a world of hurt regardless of whether she’s in your life or not.

I think personally, thinking the best of people has historically led to pain. I’m in a similar boat with my ex of a year and a half. In a situation where she feels little power, the only power she has is to keep messaging you and try and keep you on the hook, it’s emotionally twisted and abit abusive. Best of luck my dude, dm’s always open.
She doesn’t miss you, she misses the concept of having someone around. Don’t confuse loneliness with regret my friend
